budget.rationale: Five category rollups total $12,300–$15,550, consistent with the rounded $12,300–$15,500 band. The whole band is above target and the high case exceeds the preferred maximum; flight prices remain gated proxies.

weather.rationale: Funchal official June normals are about 65–75°F with little rain; coastal Sicily is warm/dry but the Sicily grid-cell range was not independently regenerated in this audit.

fireRisk.rationale: Moderate is the safety rating (3/5), corresponding to a 5–10% planning chance of material wildfire disruption during the exact trip window. Sicily is highly fire-prone and the July 2026 island-wide emergency confirms that the consequence can be severe. Timing matters: the regional 2023 analysis found no critical fire conditions from early summer through mid-July before a sharp late-July surge. June is meaningfully safer than July, but not low-risk.

swim.rationale: Sicily schedules repeated Cefalù, Mondello, Isola Bella, and Giardini Naxos swimming. The 72–75°F range was not independently re-extracted from OISST; if verified, it would align more naturally with the rubric's 4/5 band.

variety.rationale: Four lodging sleeps strongly cover Madeira hiking, Sicilian beaches, Palermo/Cefalù culture and food, and Etna nature.

ease.rationale: Four lodging sleeps, three base moves, two cars and a now-confirmed one-stop Lisbon–Palermo transfer are very high deterministic load, but the itinerary remains executable; Ease 2/5 is more consistent than 1/5.

food.rationale: Current operator evidence independently covers groceries in Funchal/Lisbon and Cefalù plus plain pizza/fries in Taormina and delivery/takeaway pizza in Giardini Naxos. Combined with Sicily/Madeira food appeal, this strongly supports 5/5; recheck each business for 2027.

risk.rationale: Verified 2026-07-19: the Tuesday easyJet LIS-PMO nonstop is selling in the current pattern and same-day one-stop backups (Vueling via BCN, TAP+ITA via FCO) are sold daily, so the no-same-day-recovery assumption behind 1/5 no longer holds. Madeira wind plus a separate-ticket, less-than-daily nonstop still cap this at 2/5 until June 2027 loads.

nights.rationale: Twelve hotel nights derive 5/5 under the canonical nights rubric.

novelty.rationale: Madeira and Sicily's planned regions do not repeat exact places in the documented visited list; 5/5 derives under the current rubric.

pto.rationale: Eight PTO days derive 3/5 under the slider rubric and have zero default weight.

value.outcome: A wildfire, smoke episode, evacuation, road closure, park closure, or flight disruption that materially changes the checked-in itinerary during its exact travel window.

routeProfiles.name: Madeira in June
routeProfiles.rationale: Madeira can sustain large, terrain-driven fires—the August 2024 event burned about 5,000 hectares—but June is earlier and normally milder. A single mountain road or trail closure can still remove a headline levada or ridge day.

routeProfiles.name: Sicily in June
routeProfiles.rationale: Sicily is highly fire-prone and the July 2026 island-wide emergency confirms that the consequence can be severe. Timing matters: the regional 2023 analysis found no critical fire conditions from early summer through mid-July before a sharp late-July surge. June is meaningfully safer than July, but not low-risk.

value.aggregation: The trip inherits the lowest safety score among its route profiles so one exposed base cannot be hidden by a low-risk base.
value.monitoring: Recheck official daily fire-danger maps and active incidents 14 days, 72 hours, and each morning before a rural drive or hike. A live red/extreme warning overrides this climatology.
